page.overview:
Who is Commander and Private?

Commander and Private are the characters who appear in the movie in the episode "Heat Signature." The segment of the movie seen in the episode begins with the Private saying to the Commander that he cannot see their own heat signature. Due to the screaming that occurs when the screen is not visible, it is probable that something bad happened to the people.

Their scene takes place within a submarine's control room, with the Private sitting and watching a heat signature monitor. The room has a glowing red light and is otherwise dark.
